title: Am I a Candidate for Breast Augmentation? Quick Quiz
meta_description: Should I get a boob job? Twelve yes-or-no questions on health, age, pregnancy, weight and goals, and what your score means. Your surgeon decides.
excerpt: Twelve yes-or-no questions to help you see whether breast augmentation could suit you now, what to sort out first and what to ask. Covers FDA age limits, waiting after pregnancy or weight loss, sagging, size and long-term care. Your surgeon decides at consultation.
quick_answer:
Am I a candidate for breast augmentation?

You may be if you are healthy, your breasts are fully developed, your expectations are realistic and you aren't pregnant or breastfeeding, ASPS says. The FDA approved saline implants from age 18 and silicone from 22. Its example checklist rules out surgery during an active infection or untreated breast cancer. Your surgeon decides at consultation.
